clientDiagnosesList.questionTitle: In the past 10 years, has a licensed member of the medical profession treated you for, or made a diagnosis of any of the following?

questionChoices.heartDisorder: Heart attack, chest discomfort, heart murmur, circulatory or heart disorder
questionChoices.thyroidDisorder: Thyroid disorder, elevated cholesterol, or other endocrine or metabolic disorder
questionChoices.lungDisorder: Asthma, shortness of breath, sleep apnea or any other lung/respiratory disorder
questionChoices.digestiveDisorder: Any disorder of stomach, liver, or digestive system (e.g., hepatitis, ulcer, colitis)
questionChoices.brainDisorder: Seizures, stroke, fainting, paralysis, falls, or any other disorder of brain/nervous system
questionChoices.neurologicalDisease: Alzheimers disease, dementia, memory impairment, Parkinson’s disease, or any other progressive neurological disease
questionChoices.psychiatricConditions: Emotional, nervous, or psychiatric conditions (e.g. depression, anxiety, bipolar or borderline personality disorders, Schizophrenia)
questionChoices.eyeEarNoseThroatDisorder: Disorder of eyes, ears, nose, throat
questionChoices.urinaryReproductiveDisorder: Kidney, bladder, urinary, reproductive organ, breast of prostate disorder
questionChoices.immuneDisorder: AIDS, HIV, or any other disorder of the immune system
questionChoices.dontKnow: I don't know / prefer not to answer
